program.name: Runner Volume
program.subject: Running prep
program.blurb: Three runner days: drills and leg strength, calves and core, then hill legs and hips.
program.about: The strength running needs, across three days. Running drills and single-leg strength one day; calves, shins and a runner's core the next; hill-style drives, lunges and hip work the third. Straight sets and short circuits. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Drills & legs / calves & core / hills & hips
